facts_claimed: There are 12 Jyotirlingas in total.
Somnath: Moon god (Chandra) worshipped Shiva to get rid of a curse.
Mallikarjuna: Shiva and Parvati appeared as Jyotirlinga after Ganesha and Kartikeya's competition.
Mahakaleshwar: Shiva appeared to destroy the demon Dushan.
Omkareshwar: Island shape resembles the 'Om' symbol.
Vaidyanath: Ravana worshipped Shiva on Kailash.
Bhimashankar: Shiva appeared to kill the demon Bhima, son of Kumbhakarna.
Rameshwar: Lord Rama established the linga before the war with Lanka.
Nageshwar: Shiva appeared to save his devotee Supriya from the demon Daruka.
Vishwanath: Kashi is considered the most beloved city of Shiva.
Tryambakeshwar: Shiva appeared after Sage Gautama's penance, leading to the origin of the Godavari river.
Kedarnath: Shiva appeared in the form of a bull (Nandi) after the Mahabharata war.
Ghushmeshwar: Shiva appeared due to the unwavering devotion of Ghushma.
